the.source_location: British and American definite article entries and American usage note: unstressed before a vowel may be /ðɪ/. The DH-IH alternative applies only before a following source unit beginning with a vowel.

iso.source_location: ISO/IEC 27001 entry, PDF page 74 (one-based): ISO pronounced eye-so. The declared word reading retains its AY and OW vowels with S between them.

nas.source_location: Network Attached Storage entry: pronounced nass; this reference covers its native storage-word reading. Explicit spelled edits retain the independent letter-name references.

readme.source_location: README file in the data glossary. Its compositional reading is inferred as imperative read plus me using their CMU dictionary entries; the glossary does not publish an IPA transcription.

asic.source_location: Application-specific integrated circuit definition: a-sick. The capitalized technical acronym replaces CMU's unrelated AE-Z-IH-K entry in complete-source checks.

wasm.source_location: Introduction, PDF page 3: wah-zum; accent-dependent rhyme with awesome or has 'em. Stress-free phone variants infer the published rhyme, retaining the final weak vowel and M.

wi-fi.source_location: British and American pronunciation of the complete hyphenated word Wi-Fi

lidar.source_location: Pronunciation li-dar: long i followed by stressed dar; no unstressed vowel after D

ebitda.source_location: British pronunciation retains both T and D before final schwa

configuration.source_location: British pronunciation without /j/; schwa followed by /r/. The r-colored-schwa-before-R alternative is a coarticulation inference, not a separately published dictionary transcription.

yaml.source_location: Abstract: YAML rhymes with camel; initial Y plus the dictionary camel rhyme

covid.source_location: Covid noun, also COVID; pronunciation entry

presents.source_location: Verb forms: he / she / it presents
